title: DashFlow Version Manifest Schema
description: Schema definition for DashFlow update feed manifest (version.json)

latestVersion.description: The latest available desktop release version (SemVer).

minVersion.description: The minimum allowed desktop version. Versions below this will be locked out until updated.

releaseNotes.description: Bullet points highlighting what's new in this release.

downloadUrl.description: Direct download link to the Windows installer .exe file.

releasePageUrl.description: Web URL to the GitHub release page.

mandatoryMessage.description: Custom notice displayed when an outdated client is locked out.

sha256.description: Optional SHA256 cryptographic hash of the installer for checksum verification.
